name: Trace Constellation
pitch: Your coding history becomes a living constellation, illuminated one day at a time.
tradeoff: Spatial atmosphere gives up the precise daily comparisons of a conventional stacked chart.
fontWhy: Geometric display forms meet compact interface labels and monospaced, stable data numerals.
logoIdea: Four connected observation points form an open R whose departing leg continues the run.
sliderIdea: Two tactile handles frame a miniature daily trace; playback ignites successive days in the window.
signatureMotion: Measured particles drift along the curved trace and fade as the selected days move.
